name: AC repair

name: Urgent leak
title: Water leaking through a ceiling
workingHours: Checks for danger, connects the caller to your office and reserves an urgent visit.
afterHours: Checks for danger. If anyone is at risk, it tells them to call 911 and alerts your on-call worker.
callerPrompt: There's water pouring through my ceiling right now!
agentResponse: I'm Talkera Desk, an AI assistant. If anyone is in physical danger, please hang up and call 911 now. Is anyone in danger?
callerFollowup: No danger, but it's getting worse quickly.
agentResolution: Understood. I am alerting our on-call technician Mike right now, holding an urgent slot, and texting you details.

callerFollowup: Yes, please ask her to check invoice #1042.
agentResolution: I sent Sarah your note about invoice 1042. I will text you to confirm.
